title: Blueberry Water Kefir
excerpt: Learn how to prepare a refreshing water kefir infused with Fresh Pick blueberries. An effervescent, fruity, homemade beverage.
imageAlt: A clear glass with deep purple-tinted water kefir, with fine bubbles, ice, and floating blueberries.

ingredients.text: 1 liter of plain water kefir (first fermentation)
1 teaspoon of ground panela (unrefined cane sugar)

steps: In a shallow bowl, gently mash the Fresh Pick blueberries with the ground panela using a fork to release their signature juice.

We use only 1 teaspoon of panela (half the usual amount) because Fresh Pick blueberries, grown at over 2,800 m.a.s.l. in Guasca, have between 13° and 15° Brix of natural sweetness, perfect for activating the second fermentation without overloading with sugar.
Transfer the mashed blueberry mixture and the strip of lemon peel into an airtight glass bottle.
Pour the liter of plain water kefir over the fruit, leaving a space of about 4 centimeters free in the neck of the bottle.
Seal the bottle tightly and let it rest in a cool, dark place for 24 hours at room temperature so that it gains carbonation and color.
After 24 hours, place the bottle in the refrigerator to stop fermentation. Serve very cold with ice and enjoy its fine bubbles.
tips: When mashing the fruit, notice that we reduce the sweetener by half, since the natural fructose of our high-mountain blueberries perfectly feeds your kefir's cultures.
Once opened, always keep the kefir covered in the refrigerator for up to 5 days to maintain its fresh bubbles and delicious fruity flavor.
